name: dsh-desktop
description: Desktop shell for a local DeepSeek Harness engine.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && vite build
scripts.package:win: npm run prepare:win && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --win dir --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:installer: npm run prepare:win && node scripts/prepare-installer.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.release:github: npm run prepare:win && node scripts/prepare-installer.mjs --require-update-feed && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --win nsis --x64 --publish always
